done_when: On Windows, codex.identity reads a process's start time and executable path through the Windows API with ctypes (OpenProcess, GetProcessTimes, QueryFullProcessImageNameW) instead of running PowerShell, so no child process is started; identity keeps its contract (None when no process has the id, a matching record otherwise, and a reused id never matches); POSIX is unchanged; a test on Windows exercises a live process, an exited one and a mismatch
why: On Windows, Forge's process check (codex.identity) shells out to PowerShell Get-CimInstance, and CI shows that call sometimes never returns: a pytest worker hung in subprocess communicate() during crash recovery (test_codex_resume.py test_9), like the earlier Windows hang in test_4
